  Scenario: AC9 The rules with no criterion hold on the owners' contract responses and events (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the journey of business date 2026-11-25 has run to its end on the owners' contracts
    When the harness reads the answers and events that carry rules BR2, BR3, BR4, BR5, BR6, BR8, BR9 and BR14
    Then each of those rules holds on the owner's contract response or event and the harness re-implements none of them
    And a rule with no contract answer or event fails the run and names the rule and the owner

  Scenario: AC10 A retried or timed-out activity produces one effect and names the timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given one activity of a hop is retried or does not finish inside the 2 s budget
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-11-25
    Then the retry produces one effect and the repeat is counted
    And a timed-out activity is reported with MSG-GEN-006 and the earlier state is unchanged
    And the run is reported failed when the retry limit is reached and is never reported passed

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the hop and moves nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call of one hop fails or does not answer
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-11-25
    Then the hop stops and the run names the owner, the operation and the contract version
    And no state change, decision record or outbox row of that hop is written
    And the run is reported failed and is never reported passed
